description.describe_ch: 從策略性的觀點，研討行銷管理的程序，包括分析行銷環境、策略性行銷決策、戰術性行銷決策，以及執行與控制等，期使能結合理論與實務，提昇行銷管理素養，並培養分析判斷之能力。
description.describe_eh: To understand the overall concepts and theory of marketing management from strategic point of view.  To discuss the marketing management process, including marketing environment analyzing, strategic marketing decision making, static marketing decision making, implementing and controlling.  To apply the marketing management theory to the practical cases.
description.pre_subname: ECON1001經濟學(一)、ECON1002經濟學(二)、MKT1019行銷管理、MGT1002企業概論
description.pre_sub_ename: ECON1001 ECONOMICS(1)、ECON1002 ECONOMICS(2)、MKT1019 MARKETING MANAGEMENT、MGT1002 INTRODUCTION TO BUSINESS
